Bucket: range-asymmetry-BTN-vs-MP-coordinated-3way-SRP-IP-closing. Hero's continuing range at BTN closing action on QhJc9d facing MP's 26% 3-way c-bet with CO sandwiched is composed of: made straights KT/AT/T9/T8 (small slice, mostly raising for value-protection on a board where every two-pair and set is vulnerable to chop or runout); sets QQ/JJ/99 (rare, raise-for-protection); two-pair QJ/J9/Q9; top-pair-Q with broadway kickers; J+kicker pairs that mix call/fold; KQ as TP-blocker plus open-ended-ish equity; nut-gutshot/overcard combos like AdKd, AKo, KTs (but KT is straight); and a slim airy bluff-catch slice. The range is COMPOSITION-HEAVY in marginal made hands that prefer to CALL and let CO crush out behind, plus a smaller raise-for-protection slice on the strongest straights/sets.

AdKd's role in this range: it is the prototypical SEMI-BLUFF RAISE candidate by structural argument — A-blocker takes AT (nut straight) out of villain's continue/raise range, K-blocker takes KT out, and it carries 4 nut-straight outs to any T plus 6 overcard outs that promote to TP+ on A/K runouts (effective 10ish outs with realization adjustment for 3-way). Against MP's c-bet range (~70% on this texture, capped of premium overpairs because AA/KK/QQ frequently size up or trap, but full of broadway air and TP-Q) the fold equity story is real on the MP side; against CO's flat-then-flat range (capped, no AK/AA, contains KT/JT/T9/Q9s/Js9s/sets-rare) raising charges out CO's bluffcatchers but folds out nothing CO continues with except backdoor air.

The range-construction tension: hero NEEDS a raising bluff in this node to balance the value raises (KT/AT/sets/two-pair). AdKd, AKo, and a fraction of KQ/QTss are the natural bluff-raise candidates by blocker logic. But the modal action remains CALL because (a) CO behind is the structural problem — raising bloats pot with one player yet to act who can squeeze-jam or cold-call with dominating made hands; (b) realizing equity at 26% pot odds with 10-out semi-bluff equity 3-way is mechanically cheap and position-leveraged; (c) implied odds on T are large since villains pay off TP+ stacks; (d) calling protects hero's range — pure raising AdKd while flatting weaker gutshots polarizes the call range. Frequency anchor: AdKd raises at modest frequency (~30%) as part of the bluff-raise slice balancing the value raises; calls the majority (~70%) to realize equity in position while CO is still live. Modal action: CALL. Adjacent alternatives: FOLD is dominated (price + equity + position); RAISE-to-~10bb is the mixable minority action selecting on blocker strength.
